properties.title: Threat report · Pattonville Heights Middle School
properties.address: Pattonville Heights Middle School, Maryland Heights, MO
properties.source: First Alert 4 · Maryland Heights Police reporting
properties.description: Maryland Heights police reported threats directed at staff and students of Pattonville Heights Middle School on November 14. An adult was arrested November 16 and charged with making a terrorist threat. Police said there was no active threat to the community. The marker identifies the affected public school, not where the threats originated.
properties.locationAccuracy: Affected public school, rounded to about 100 m; the location where the threats originated was not reported.

properties.title: Fatal officer shooting investigation · Dutchtown
properties.description: Police reported an attempted carjacking and threats with what investigators later identified as a BB pistol. Officers shot the suspect, who died at hospital. No officers or other citizens were reported injured. Preliminary official report; not a finding of guilt. Incident time is approximate. Location is an approximate area, not an exact scene.
properties.address: 4000 block of Meramec at Gustine Avenue, St. Louis, MO

fatalityEvidence.summary: SLMPD states responding officers fired shots, struck the person, and the person died at a hospital.

properties.title: Officer shooting investigation · Lindell Marketplace
properties.description: Police reported a security officer fired a shot following reported threats and a pursuit. A suspect was detained; no injuries were reported. Preliminary official report; not a finding of guilt. Incident time is approximate. Location is an approximate area, not an exact scene.
properties.address: Lindell Marketplace area, St. Louis, MO
